# Endpoint reference

Every endpoint the SDKs wrap and its method name in each SDK.

Auth column: **Signed (V1/V2)** = signature headers (SDK default V2); **Signed (V2 only)** = V1 is rejected; **Bearer** = call `login()` first (or set `access_token`); **Signed or Bearer** = either a valid signature or a Bearer token; **None** = public.
